trips_notes: Journal Métro (2015) states 2011 and 2012 had 4.1 and 4.4 million trips respectively — a rounded figure, not an exact press-release total like 2009-2011.
Mid-way through 2012, BIXI had already reported trips up 10%, surpassing 2.7 million and representing 54% of its 2012 target.
The CIRRELT paper, using BIXI's raw transaction data, independently confirms the system reached a peak of 4.4 million transactions and 40,000 members in 2012.

trips_notes: IMPORTANT: this figure is an ESTIMATE, not a confirmed exact total — no press release or dataset with a precise 2013 year-end trip count was found.

The CIRRELT paper states ridership peaked in 2012 and was stable since; its regression tables show 2013 had 81,722 station-days of activity versus 83,193 in 2012, implying a near-identical scale of operation.
Le Devoir reports 2014 had 33,216 active members, down 6.5% from 35,548 in 2013, and 3.2 million trips in 2014 (4% below the five-year average) — implying 2013 was meaningfully above 3.2 million.

toolsofchange.com states more than 13 million trips had been made since the 2009 launch by 2013 — but this is lower than simply summing the confirmed 2009-2012 totals (~13.0 million), so it's a loosely rounded milestone, not a precise year-end tally, and was not used to derive the estimate above.
